description.value: Subjects with suspected neurodegenerative dementia disorder were recruited retrospectively from all brain FDG PET examinations performed at the Department of Nuclear Medicine of the University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf between March 2002 and January 2006. Inclusion criteria were that brain FDG PET had been performed for early diagnosis or differential diagnosis of neurodegenerative dementia disorder and that Alzheimer's disease, Lewy-Body disease, fronto-temporal dementia, or cortico-basal dementia had been clearly stated in the conclusion of the PET report. The exclusion criterion was any reported PET finding not related to the diagnosis of neurodegenerative disease.
